issue.author: justinfargnoli
issue.body:
Lowering `v2i8` as a return type is causing a compiler crash. 

Reproducer on compiler explorer: https://godbolt.org/z/znxzW9Eqj

_Originally posted by @Artem-B in https://github.com/llvm/llvm-project/pull/104524#discussion_r1722353170_

comments.author: justinfargnoli
justinfargnoli
comments.body: This is caused by `SelectionDAG` wanting to lower `v2i8` as ***1*** `v2i16` value while `ComputePTXValueVTs` wants to lower it to ***2*** `i8` values.

comments.author: justinfargnoli
comments.body: @manasij7479 is going to look into this.

issue.title: [NVPTX] Failure to lower `v2i8`
